import ctypes
import os

# Load the required libraries
libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

# Define the gsl_sf_bessel_Inu function signature
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Inu.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Inu.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_bessel_inu(nu, x):
    """
    Compute the modified Bessel function of the first kind I_nu(x).

    Parameters:
        nu (float): Order of the Bessel function.
        x (float): Argument of the Bessel function.

    Returns:
        float: Computed value of I_nu(x).
    """
    if nu < 0 or x < 0:
        raise ValueError("Both nu and x must be non-negative.")

    result = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Inu(ctypes.c_double(nu), ctypes.c_double(x))
    return result

def assert_test():
    """Run assertion tests to validate the implementation."""
    # Test cases
    assert abs(compute_bessel_inu(0, 1) - 1.2660658777520082) < 1e-6, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_inu(1, 1) - 0.565159103992485) < 1e-6, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_inu(2, 1) - 0.1357476697670383) < 1e-6, "Test case 3 failed"

    # Edge cases
    assert abs(compute_bessel_inu(0, 0) - 1.0) < 1e-6, "Edge case 1 failed"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_inu(1, 0) - 0.0) < 1e-6, "Edge case 2 failed"

    # Error handling
    try:
        compute_bessel_inu(-1, 1)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Both nu and x must be non-negative.", "Error handling test case 1 failed"

    try:
        compute_bessel_inu(1, -1)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Both nu and x must be non-negative.", "Error handling test case 2 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
